sentences.en: And the special counsel would specifically look at the election.

sentences.en: So now you have a situation where there's a huge investigation into the president.

sentences.en: That's up for debate.

sentences.en: And we would have used a, put a different attorney general in.

sentences.en: Their fear, of course, is that it would put the majorities of Republicans in jeopardy ahead of the midterMs.

sentences.zh: 不过，这种担忧在12月上旬烟消云散了，因为

sentences.en: Donald Trump, having noticed that there was quite a furor over Matt Whitaker, came out and said, I have found my new attorney general.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普注意到围绕马特·惠特克的轩然大波后，公开表示：我找到了我的新司法部长。

sentences.en: Bill Barr will be nominated for the United States attorney general position.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔将被提名担任美国司法部长职位。

sentences.en: I think he will serve with great distinction.
sentences.zh: 我认为他将以卓越的声誉服务。

sentences.en: And it will be William Barr.
sentences.zh: 这个人就是威廉·巴尔。

sentences.en: A terrific man, a terrific person, a brilliant man.
sentences.zh: 一个极好的人，一个了不起的人，一个才华横溢的人。

sentences.en: And who is William Barr?
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔是谁？

sentences.en: William Barr is a classic Republican.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔是一位典型的共和党人。

sentences.en: Coming up next, it's coverage of today's Senate Judiciary Committee hearing on the nomination of William Barr,
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们将报道今天参议院司法委员会关于威廉·巴尔提名的听证会，

sentences.en: President Bush's choice to be the nation's new attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他是老布什总统挑选的国家新任司法部长。

sentences.en: He was the attorney general under George H.W.
sentences.zh: 他是老布什

sentences.en: Bush and was known at that time as the boy A.G.
sentences.zh: 政府时期的司法部长，当时被称为“男孩司法部长”。

sentences.en: He was so young.
sentences.zh: 他太年轻了。

sentences.en: He was in his early 40s.
sentences.zh: 他刚四十出头。

sentences.en: William Barr is 41 years of age.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔今年41岁。

sentences.en: He worked for the Central Intelligence Agency and the D.C.
sentences.zh: 他曾在中央情报局和哥伦比亚特区

sentences.en: Circuit Court of Appeals before joining with President Reagan's transition team.
sentences.zh: 巡回上诉法院工作，后来加入里根总统的过渡团队。

sentences.en: And he came up through the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 他是在司法部一步步升上来的。

sentences.en: He had been the head of the Office of Legal Counsel.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任法律顾问办公室主任。

sentences.en: He'd been the deputy attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任副司法部长。

sentences.en: And then he was the attorney general of the United States.
sentences.zh: 后来他担任了美国司法部长。

sentences.en: I'm honored that the president has selected me for the position of attorney general.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸总统选择我担任司法部长一职。

sentences.en: I believe I am in a good position to provide leadership to the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 我相信我有能力领导司法部。

sentences.en: So a highly credentialed Republican legal figure in the traditional mold of the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个具有传统司法部长风格、资历深厚的共和党法律界人士。

sentences.en: And not just highly credentialed.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是资历深厚。

sentences.en: He has also revered, especially amongst conservative legal circles, for being such a sharp legal mind.
sentences.zh: 他在保守派法律界也备受尊崇，因为他有着敏锐的法律头脑。

sentences.en: The thing with being the attorney general is that you are a political appointee.
sentences.zh: 作为司法部长，你的身份是一个政治任命官员。

sentences.en: You're the face of the department.
sentences.zh: 你是司法部的门面。

sentences.en: You're kind of famous, at least you're D.C.
sentences.zh: 你算是个名人，至少在华盛顿特区

sentences.en: famous.
sentences.zh: 是名人。

sentences.en: But you do not have to be the best lawyer in the world.
sentences.zh: 但你不需要成为世界上最好的律师。

sentences.en: William Barr, on the other hand, some would argue, is one of the best lawyers in the world.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，有人会认为威廉·巴尔是世界上最好的律师之一。

sentences.en: But William
sentences.zh: 但威廉

sentences.en: Barr is a really low-key guy.
sentences.zh: ·巴尔是一个非常低调的人。

sentences.en: If you think about the two years when he was attorney general, there were huge cases that came before the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 如果你回想他担任司法部长的两年时间，司法部曾处理过许多重大案件。

sentences.en: The Rodney King riots, the Talladega prison uprising, and the shooting at Ruby Ridge.
sentences.zh: 罗德尼·金骚乱、塔拉德加监狱暴动，以及红宝石岭枪击案。

sentences.en: We remember all of those things so well, but we don't remember the name William Barr.
sentences.zh: 我们对所有这些事情都记忆犹新，但我们却不记得威廉·巴尔这个名字。

sentences.en: And I think that speaks to the way that he handled those cases.
sentences.zh: 我认为这说明了他处理这些案件的方式。

sentences.en: He consulted with his staff.
sentences.zh: 他与他的幕僚进行了磋商。

sentences.en: He relied heavily on the people in the Solicitor General's
sentences.zh: 他非常依赖副总检察长

sentences.en: Office and the Office of Legal Counsel.
sentences.zh: 办公室和法律顾问办公室的人员。

sentences.en: And then he took their guidance, and he decided to do what the department needed to do.
sentences.zh: 然后他采纳了他们的指导意见，并决定做司法部需要做的事情。

sentences.en: He wasn't really a public face.
sentences.zh: 他并不是一个真正抛头露面的人。

sentences.en: AG's come and go.
sentences.zh: 司法部长来来往往。

sentences.en: And if you confirm me, I would like, at the conclusion of my tenure, to have it said that I upheld the law and that I
sentences.zh: 如果你们批准我的任命，我希望在我任期结束时，人们会说我捍卫了法律，并且我

sentences.en: left the Department of Justice a more effective, stronger, and a better institution.
sentences.zh: 让司法部成为一个更高效、更强大、更好的机构。

sentences.en: So it sounds like he is a very safe and solid choice.
sentences.zh: 听起来他是一个非常稳妥可靠的人选。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that was the point, that the president specifically chose someone who was so obviously qualified and credentialed because of the perception,
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否正是关键所在，总统特意选择了一个资历如此明显、资格如此之高的人，因为人们

sentences.en: at least by some, especially Democrats, that Matt Whitaker was a partisan and not nearly as qualified.
sentences.zh: 尤其是民主党人普遍认为马特·惠特克带有党派倾向，且资历远不够。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I think that both inside the Justice Department and inside the White House, people were incredibly relieved to have somebody finally, hopefully, act as attorney general who
sentences.zh: 我认为无论是司法部内部还是白宫内部，人们都极其庆幸终于能有一位司法部长，希望他能

sentences.en: would bring to an end this era of complete chaos that had engulfed the Justice Department and its relationship with the president.
sentences.zh: 终结笼罩着司法部及其与总统关系的完全混乱的时代。

sentences.en: But just a week later, things shifted again.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅一周后，情况又发生了变化。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, we saw that William Barr had written a memo and sent it over to the Justice Department saying that he had real concerns about Robert Mueller's investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们看到威廉·巴尔写了一份备忘录并送交司法部，称他对罗伯特·穆勒的调查深表关切。

sentences.en: In a memo from this past summer, Bill Barr called the obstruction inquiry, quote, fatally misconceived with potentially disastrous implications for the presidency,
sentences.zh: 在今年夏天的一份备忘录中，比尔·巴尔称妨碍司法公正的调查“存在根本性缺陷，对总统职权具有潜在的灾难性影响”，

sentences.en: saying Trump's firing of former FBI Director James Comey was within the power of the president.
sentences.zh: 并称特朗普解雇前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米在总统的权力范围内。

sentences.en: He doesn't think that it's the case that the president obstructed justice by firing essentially his employee, somebody who he has every right to fire.
sentences.zh: 他不认为总统解雇本质上是自己下属、一个他完全有权解雇的人构成了妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: Barr wrote the memo speaking as a former attorney general under President George H.W.
sentences.zh: 巴尔在撰写该备忘录时是以老布什

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 总统时期前司法部长的身份发表意见的。

sentences.en: Sources tell CNN Barr discussed the memo with the president, pointing out it could be a sticking point for his confirmation.
sentences.zh: 消息人士告诉美国有线电视新闻网，巴尔曾与总统讨论过该备忘录，指出这可能会成为他获得确认的一个绊脚石。

sentences.en: Now, past Justice Department employees, they are all attorneys.
sentences.zh: 过去的司法部员工，他们都是律师。

sentences.en: They are incredibly opinionated people.
sentences.zh: 他们都是极有主见的人。

sentences.en: But writing a very, very long, extremely detailed, argued memo about aspects of an investigation of which he admits in the memo he doesn't know, he doesn't understand, and he has
sentences.zh: 但是，针对一项他自己在备忘录中承认自己并不了解、不理解且毫无

sentences.en: no details about, that is unusual.
sentences.zh: 细节的调查的各个方面，撰写一份非常非常长、极其详尽且充满论证的备忘录，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: So that seems like a pretty big red flag at this moment when one of, as you said, the biggest pieces
sentences.zh: 因此，在穆勒调查中正如你所说最大的一部分正在调查总统是否妨碍司法公正的关键时刻，这似乎是一个相当大的危险信号。

sentences.en: of the Mueller investigation is investigating whether the president obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 这部分内容正在调查总统是否妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: So how do all these constituencies who are so nervous about who the next attorney general will be and what they will do with the Russia investigation, how do they respond?
sentences.zh: 那么，所有这些对下一任司法部长是谁以及他们将如何处理俄罗斯调查感到如此紧张的各方会如何反应呢？

sentences.en: They immediately start calling for an explanation.
sentences.zh: 他们立即开始要求给出解释。

sentences.en: They want to know why Barr wrote the memo, and they want to know what Barr's thoughts on the Mueller investigation are today.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道巴尔为什么要写这份备忘录，并想知道巴尔今天对穆勒调查有什么看法。

sentences.en: Democrats wanted to hear much more than what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 民主党人希望听到的远不止他所说的那样。

sentences.en: They were not satisfied at that point.
sentences.zh: 他们在那个阶段并不满意。

sentences.en: The fact that as a citizen, he filed this 19-page memo.
sentences.zh: 作为一个普通公民，他提交了这份19页的备忘录。

sentences.en: I don't have citizens that do that.
sentences.zh: 我的选民里可没有这样的人。

sentences.en: They might, you know, send me 19 characters and a tweet about an issue.
sentences.zh: 他们可能只会针对某个问题发一条19个字符的推文。

sentences.en: But he filed suddenly a 19-page issue like a tryout for this job.
sentences.zh: 但他却突然提交了一份19页的问题清单，就像是在为这份工作进行试镜一样。

sentences.en: But you have some real issues here that we're going to have to question him about under oath.
sentences.zh: 但这里确实存在一些实质性问题，我们必须就此对他进行宣誓质询。

sentences.en: I share many of Mr. Barr's thoughts about the consequences of obstruction justice for personnel decisions.
sentences.zh: 我非常赞同巴尔先生关于对人事决策进行妨碍司法公正调查的后果的许多看法。

sentences.en: But having said that, he'll need to defend his reasoning.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，他仍需为自己的推理进行辩护。

sentences.en: William Barr was sending freelance memos to the Trump administration, making a case to undercut the
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔一直在向特朗普政府发送非官方备忘录，试图削弱

sentences.en: Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 穆勒的调查。

sentences.en: So the deep concern will be, is this just a preface to either undercutting the investigation or trying to keep the results of it hidden from the American public?
sentences.zh: 因此，人们深度担忧的是，这是否只是削弱调查或者试图向美国公众隐瞒调查结果的前奏？

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: And how does he respond?
sentences.zh: 他是如何回应的？

sentences.en: So Barr goes to the Hill, and he starts the work of calming people down.
sentences.zh: 于是巴尔前往国会山，开始做平息人们情绪的工作。

sentences.en: William Barr meeting with lawmakers on Capitol Hill last week.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔上周在国会山与议员会面。

sentences.en: William Barr speaking with Democratic and Republican senators, including Senate Majority Leader
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔与民主党和共和党参议员交谈，其中包括参议院多数党领袖

sentences.en: Mitch McConnell.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔。

sentences.en: William Barr met with Republican Senator Lindsey Graham earlier.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔早些时候会见了共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: The South Carolina lawmaker told reporters Barr has agreed to allow Mueller to finish his job.
sentences.zh: 这位南卡罗来纳州议员告诉记者，巴尔已同意让穆勒完成他的工作。

sentences.en: I asked Mr. Barr directly, do you think Mr. Mueller's on a witch hunt?
sentences.zh: 我直接问了巴尔先生，你认为穆勒先生是在搞政治迫害吗？

sentences.en: He said no.
sentences.zh: 他说没有。

sentences.en: Do you think he would be fair to the president and the country as a whole?
sentences.zh: 你认为他对总统和整个国家会公正吗？

sentences.en: He said yes.
sentences.zh: 他说会的。

sentences.en: So ahead of today's confirmation hearings, Barr has basically run a kind of mini-PR campaign
sentences.zh: 因此，在今天的听证会之前，巴尔基本上开展了一场微型公关活动，

sentences.en: to make sure that senators don't think that he will interfere with the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 以确保参议员们不会认为他会干预俄罗斯调查。

sentences.en: And he's basically saying, trust me, despite what I have said or written in this memo, that I will not touch the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，请相信我，尽管我在这份备忘录中所说或所写过什么，但我不会插手穆勒的调查。

sentences.en: Has that worked?
sentences.zh: 这起作用了吗？

sentences.en: It for now has worked.
sentences.zh: 目前来看起作用了。

sentences.en: But we will see what happens during the hearing.
sentences.zh: 但我们将拭目以待听证会期间会发生什么。

sentences.en: A lot's going to ride on his performance.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上要看他在听证会上的表现。

sentences.en: He's going to be asked all these same questions again.
sentences.zh: 人们会再次向他提出所有这些相同的问题。

sentences.en: And how he answers and how convincing he is in that setting is going to go a lot further than the private meetings that he just had on the Hill.
sentences.zh: 他在那种场合下如何回答以及表现得多么令人信服，将比他刚刚在国会山进行的私人会谈产生更深远的影响。

sentences.en: You know, what's interesting, Katie, is that from the start, the president has been really at odds with
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，有趣的是，从一开始，总统就一直与

sentences.en: his own Department of Justice because of the depth of his resentment over the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 他自己的司法部处于对立状态，因为他对俄罗斯调查有着极深的怨恨。

sentences.en: He was furious at his first hand-picked attorney general, Jeff Sessions, because he recused himself
sentences.zh: 他对他的第一任亲手挑选的司法部长杰夫·塞申斯愤怒不已，因为塞申斯回避了

sentences.en: from the investigation and because it was suddenly under the control of a person that he couldn't really influence, Rod Rosenstein.
sentences.zh: 调查，并且因为这项调查突然落入了一个他无法真正施加影响的人罗德·罗森斯坦的控制之下。

sentences.en: Then he appoints a temporary attorney general who immediately comes under a cloud of suspicion and who never really gets a chance to be in charge of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 然后他任命了一位临时司法部长，该人立即陷入重重疑云之中，且从未真正有机会掌管这项调查。

sentences.en: Now, finally, if Barr is confirmed, the president will have an attorney general who won't recuse himself
sentences.zh: 现在，如果巴尔最终获得确认，总统将拥有一位不会主动回避的司法部长，

sentences.en: and will more or less oversee the Russia probe in the way that the president wants.
sentences.zh: 并且会或多或少地按照总统希望的方式监督俄罗斯调查。

sentences.en: Does that mean that the president's relationship with the Department of Justice will finally become more civil and productive?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着总统与司法部的关系最终会变得更加文明和富有成效？

sentences.en: I think this is a huge question for Barr.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对巴尔来说是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: He has a big job to do.
sentences.zh: 他有一项重任在肩。

sentences.en: He needs to both rehabilitate the relationship with the White House and he needs to improve morale inside of the building, which is
sentences.zh: 他既需要修复与白宫的关系，又需要提振大楼内部的士气，

sentences.en: pretty low after almost two years of constant attacks from the White House.
sentences.zh: 在白宫长达近两年的持续攻击之后，这里的士气已经相当低落。

sentences.en: One of the things about William Barr that people expect, including people at the White House, is that he will say no to the president and he will be willing to defy the president.
sentences.zh: 人们对威廉·巴尔的期望之一，包括白宫内部的人，就是他会对总统说不，并且敢于违抗总统。

sentences.en: William Barr is not coming into the job as a former Trump campaign official and he's not coming into the job as one of the president's
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔上任时并非特朗普竞选团队的前官员，他也不是像杰夫·塞申斯那样作为总统

sentences.en: first and earliest and staunchest supporters as Jeff Sessions did.
sentences.zh: 最初、最早和最坚定的支持者之一上任的。

sentences.en: He is coming into the job largely independent.
sentences.zh: 他的上任基本上是独立的。

sentences.en: And so I think there's more of an expectation of independence from him than there was with Sessions.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为人们对他的独立性抱有比对塞申斯更高的期望。

sentences.en: So whether or not Barr can walk the fine line between doing his job, which sometimes means saying no to the president, and making sure that that doesn't spill over into
sentences.zh: 所以，巴尔能否在履行职责（有时这意味着对总统说不）与确保这种职责不会演变成

sentences.en: this acrimonious relationship again, that's going to be really difficult.
sentences.zh: 这种充满怨恨的关系之间走好钢丝，这将是非常困难的。

sentences.en: But I think he has a way better chance of doing it than Jeff Sessions ever did.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他做到的几率比杰夫·塞申斯以往任何时候都要大得多。

sentences.en: I wonder if at the end of the day, having
sentences.zh: 我想知道，到头来，让

sentences.en: Sessions and having Rosenstein in these powerful positions, which is about to end, if having them
sentences.zh: 塞申斯和罗森斯坦担任这些即将结束的权力职位，让

sentences.en: as kind of foils and punching bags was really useful for the president because it allowed him to cast
sentences.zh: 他们扮演类似挡箭牌和出气筒的角色对总统来说是否真的很有用，因为这让他能够

sentences.en: doubt on the Russia investigation and frankly, any investigation he didn't like that the Justice
sentences.zh: 对俄罗斯调查以及坦白说司法部接手的任何他不喜欢的调查

sentences.en: Department overtook.
sentences.zh: 产生怀疑。

sentences.en: Does that mean that having someone like Barr, is that going to make it harder for the president to attack these investigations and try to undermine them?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着拥有像巴尔这样的人，会让总统更难攻击这些调查并试图破坏它们？

sentences.en: I don't think that the president sees a world in which just because he chose somebody for a job, he can't attack them.
sentences.zh: 我不认为总统会认为只要自己选了某个人任职，就不能攻击他们。

sentences.en: There's nothing in the last two years of his presidency to suggest that.
sentences.zh: 他过去两年的总统任期内没有任何迹象表明这一点。

sentences.en: So even though he's nominated William Barr and he wants Barr to become the attorney general, he also nominated Sessions,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管他提名了威廉·巴尔并希望巴尔成为司法部长，但他也曾提名过塞申斯，

sentences.en: he also nominated Rosenstein, and was happy when it suited him to turn on them.
sentences.zh: 也提名过罗森斯坦，并且在对己有利时很高兴翻脸不认人。

sentences.en: But Barr is a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 但巴尔有点不同。

sentences.en: He's already done the job.
sentences.zh: 他已经干过这工作了。

sentences.en: He's already been attorney general and has a sterling reputation to preserve.
sentences.zh: 他已经当过司法部长，并且有极高的声誉需要维护。

sentences.en: I don't anticipate a world in which he will not push back and try to defend the department and the people who work there when the president does attack.
sentences.zh: 我不认为当总统发起攻击时，他会不进行反击并试图捍卫司法部及在那里工作的人。

sentences.en: I wonder though if that's a recipe for a very short-lived attorney generalship.
sentences.zh: 不过我在想，这是否注定会让他的司法部长任期非常短暂。

sentences.en: Someone who sees his role as protecting the department and standing up to the president.
sentences.zh: 一个将自己的角色视为保护司法部和顶住总统压力的人。

sentences.en: I think it's part of the job of the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是司法部长职责的一部分。

sentences.en: And could it mean that he has a very short term in the office?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着他在任时间会非常短？

sentences.en: It could.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: That said, if you're William Barr and you have this sterling reputation, which would you rather do?
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果你是威廉·巴尔，并且你拥有这种极高的声誉，你更愿意怎么做？

sentences.en: Be attorney general for a few months and go down in a blaze of glory because you defended the department in a tough time, or say nothing and be considered forever in
sentences.zh: 当几个月的司法部长，然后在艰难时期捍卫司法部而轰轰烈烈地倒下，还是什么都不说，在历史书中永远被视为

sentences.en: the history books as somebody who remained silent and allowed the president to trample on the department that you once represented.
sentences.zh: 一个保持沉默并允许总统践踏你曾经代表过的司法部的人。

sentences.en: Katie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: In his written testimony for today's confirmation hearing, William Barr pledged to allow the special counsel's office
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔在今天听证会的书面证词中承诺，将允许特别检察官办公室

sentences.en: to finish its investigation and said it is, quote, very important that the public be informed of the investigation's results.
sentences.zh: 完成其调查，并表示“让公众了解调查结果非常重要”。

sentences.en: The country needs a credible resolution of these issues, Barr wrote.
sentences.zh: 巴尔写道，国家需要对这些问题有一个可信的结论。

sentences.en: If confirmed, I will not permit partisan politics, personal interests, or any other improper consideration to interfere with this or any other investigation.
sentences.zh: 如果获得确认，我绝不允许党派政治、个人利益或任何其他不当考量干涉本次或任何其他调查。

sentences.en: Barr's testimony before the Senate is scheduled for 9.30 this morning.
sentences.zh: 巴尔在参议院的证词预定于今天上午9点30分进行。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump rejected a proposal made by a close
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统拒绝了关系密切的共和党盟友

sentences.en: Republican ally, Senator Lindsey Graham, to reopen the government temporarily to negotiate funding for
sentences.zh: 林赛·格雷厄姆参议员提出的暂时重开政府以谈判资金的提议

sentences.en: a border wall before resorting to an emergency declaration that would allow Trump to start building the wall without Congress's consent.
sentences.zh: 在诉诸允许特朗普未经国会同意就开始修建边境墙的紧急状态令之前。

sentences.en: I would urge him to open up the government for a short period of time, like three weeks, before he pulls the plug.
sentences.zh: 我敦促他在彻底放弃之前，先让政府重新开门一小段时间，比如三个星期。

sentences.en: See if we can get a deal.
sentences.zh: 看看我们能不能达成协议。

sentences.en: If we can, at the end of three weeks, all bets are off.
sentences.zh: 如果能的话，在三周结束时，一切都说不准了。

sentences.en: See if he can do it by himself through the emergency powers.
sentences.zh: 看看他是否能通过紧急权力独自做到这一点。

sentences.en: That's my recommendation.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的建议。

sentences.en: Asked about the proposal on the White House lawn, Trump said it was insufficient.
sentences.zh: 在白宫草坪上被问及该提议时，特朗普表示这还远远不够。

sentences.en: Well, that was the suggestion that Lindsey made, but I did.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是林赛提出的建议，但我确实这么做了。

sentences.en: I did reject it.
sentences.zh: 我确实拒绝了它。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm not interested.
sentences.zh: 我不感兴趣。

sentences.en: I want to get it solved.
sentences.zh: 我想把它解决掉。

sentences.en: I don't want to just delay it.
sentences.zh: 我不想只是拖延它。

sentences.en: I want to get it solved.
sentences.zh: 我想把它解决掉。

sentences.en: With no negotiations underway, the shutdown is now in its 24th day.
sentences.zh: 由于没有正在进行的谈判，政府关门现在进入了第24天。

sentences.en: And here we are on a rainy day in the richest country in the world, in the richest state in the
sentences.zh: 而现在，在这个世界上最富有的国家的雨天里，在这个国家最富有的州里

sentences.en: country, in a state as blue as it can be, and in a city rife with millionaires, where teachers have to go on strike to get the basics for our students.
sentences.zh: 在一个蓝得不能再蓝的州里，在一个百万富翁云集的城市里，教师们却不得不通过罢工来为我们的学生争取基本需求。

sentences.en: In Los Angeles on Monday, more than 30,000 public school teachers began a labor strike over demands for higher pay, smaller classes, and the need for more support staff.
sentences.zh: 周一在洛杉矶，3万多名公立学校教师开始举行罢工，要求提高薪酬、缩小班级规模并需要更多支持人员。

sentences.en: The strike is the latest case of teachers across the country walking off the job to protest working conditions.
sentences.zh: 这次罢工是全国各地教师为抗议工作条件而离岗的最新案例。

sentences.en: Last year, teachers mounted large-scale strikes in six other states, from West Virginia to Colorado.
sentences.zh: 去年，从西弗吉尼亚州到科罗拉多州，教师们在其他六个州发起了大规模罢工。

sentences.en: Los Angeles said its 900 public schools will remain open throughout the strike, staffed by substitute teachers.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶表示，其900所公立学校将在罢工期间保持开放，由代课老师负责。

sentences.en: But many parents have said they will keep their children out of school, rather than making them cross a picket line to attend class.
sentences.zh: 但许多家长表示，他们会让孩子不去上学，而不是让他们跨过纠察线去上课。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balbarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正准备为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到断片才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
